question: What attainment is identified as the root Kaula alongside the eight powers?
premises: The eight powers are referenced as attained.
The attainment of powers is equated with the root Kaula.
This identification is addressed to the fair-faced goddess.
inference: The attainment of the eight powers constitutes the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The exact scope of the eight powers is not specified in this verse alone.
plain_english: And the attainment of the eight powers is the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
